action: No action needed; for awareness. Fuji United Holdings says it will notify people whose data may have leaked individually.
date_note: Security NEXT, published 26 November, gives no earlier disclosure day; it says unauthorized access was confirmed on 5 November.
exec: Fuji United Holdings says data containing personal information leaked from a subsidiary's server after third-party access.
plain: Fuji United Holdings says part of the data on a server run by its subsidiary Fuji Kosan, including personal information, leaked after someone accessed it without permission. Other personal data on that server may also have leaked.

sources.name: Security NEXT: 個人情報含むデータが外部に流出 - 富士ユナイトHD

summary: Security NEXT reports that Fuji United Holdings found an anomaly on a server operated by its subsidiary Fuji Kosan and confirmed on 5 November that a third party had accessed it. The company says part of the data containing personal information leaked and that other personal information on the server may also have leaked. It blocked the intrusion route, strengthened log monitoring and plans to notify affected people individually.
title: Fuji United Holdings says data containing personal information leaked after third-party access to a Fuji Kosan server

validation.note: Security NEXT relays the company's announcement; the company's own page was not read. The article gives no number of people affected.
